# AmberClaw

> Open, self-hosted, zero-trust AI agent runtime.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://krishujeniya.github.io/MostlyOutlier/
> Documentation Site: https://krishujeniya.github.io/AmberClaw/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/AmberClaw

## Overview
AmberClaw is a private, zero-trust runtime designed for teams and developers executing autonomous AI agents across local and cloud environments. It isolates tool execution, safeguards API credentials in at-rest encrypted vaults, and provides full execution audit logs.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Canonical Person Entity: https://krishujeniya.github.io/#krishujeniya
- Linked Projects: AGYOS, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Curavex, Hajree, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Security Architecture
- Zero-Trust Execution: Isolated subprocess containers with strict network egress gating.
- Private Memory Vaults: Per-workspace AES-256-GCM memory encryption preventing cross-session credential leakage.
- Deterministic Tooling: Programmatic schema verification prior to function call execution.
